wasIstDas.dein_offizielles_berichtsheft_unterschre: Your official report book is signed by your training company. That is exactly why certain things never make it in: the two hours of overtime nobody wrote down. The third day in a row spent in the warehouse instead of training. The remark from your boss that still annoys you.
wasIstDas.das_schattenberichtsheft_ist_das_zweite: The shadow report book is the second logbook next to it — private, encrypted and stored on your device only. You record what actually happened, with a date. Not to get anyone in trouble, but so you still know the details later, when you want to sort it out.

wasIstDas.beim_ersten_oeffnen_legst_du: The first time you open it you set a password. Your browser derives a key from it via PBKDF2 with 600,000 iterations and encrypts every entry with AES-256-GCM. Neither the password nor the key ever leaves your device.

wasIstDas.kehrseite_ein_vergessenes_passwort_bedeu: The flip side: a forgotten password means the entries are permanently out of reach. Nobody can bring them back — not even us.
wasIstDas.ersetzt_das_schattenberichtsheft_mein_of: Does the shadow report book replace my official one?
wasIstDas.nein_der_ausbildungsnachweis_nach_13: No. The training record under § 13 BBiG stays mandatory and is still signed off by your company. The shadow report book is a private record alongside it.

wasIstDas.nicht_ueber_myworklog_die_daten: Not through MyWorkLog. The data sits encrypted in your own browser storage and is never transmitted anywhere. Without your unlocked device and your password, nobody sees a thing.

vaultCloudModal.standardmaessig_verlaesst_dieser_tresor_: By default this vault does not leave your device. Once shared, it travels with the app’s normal cloud sync — up and down. Handy when you note something down at work and carry on writing at home.

vaultCloudModal.auf_jedem_weiteren_geraet_brauchst: On every additional device you need the same vault password. If you forget it, the cloud copy will not help either.
vaultCloudModal.beweismittel_bleiben_auf_diesem_geraet: Evidence stays on this device. Only the entries travel — sharing does not upload photos, PDFs or recordings. To move them to a second device, use a backup.
vaultCloudModal.nach_dem_aufheben_wird_die: After turning sharing off, the copy is removed from the cloud with the next upload. Devices that already synced keep their local state.

mainEntity.name: What is a shadow report book?

acceptedAnswer.text: A shadow report book is a second, private log alongside the official training record. The official report book is signed by your training company, so overtime, non-training tasks or uncomfortable incidents rarely make it in. In the shadow report book you record exactly those things with a date, encrypted and for your eyes only.

mainEntity.name: Does the shadow report book replace my official one?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The training record under § 13 of the German Vocational Training Act stays mandatory and is still signed off by your company. The shadow report book runs alongside it as a private record.

mainEntity.name: What do I need the entries for later?

acceptedAnswer.text: As a dated memory aid when you want to sort something out — with your trainer, the works council for young employees, the chamber of commerce or an advice centre. Anyone recounting events months later usually has only a rough recollection. A dated note is more concrete.

Every entry is encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The key is derived from your password via PBKDF2 with 600,000 iterations and never leaves your device. There is no server, no account and no cloud copy — and therefore no recovery if you forget the password.

mainEntity.name: Can my training company see the entries?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not through MyWorkLog. The data sits encrypted in your own browser storage and is never transmitted anywhere. Without access to your unlocked device and your password, nobody sees anything.

mainEntity.name: What does the shadow report book cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nothing. It is part of MyWorkLog: free, ad-free and usable without an account.
